tagline: 理光便携相机，1992 年发布
description: 理光于1992年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/4.5 - 90mm f/7.2, 2.4X Zoom, 7 elements in 7 groups。快门速度1 - 1/400 sec.。感光度ISO 64 - 3200 (DX-code system)。5 point Multi-Beam Active AF, 650 focusing steps, 0.5 m - inf., Macro Mode focuses at fixed 0.25m.。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/4.5 - 90mm f/7.2, 2.4X Zoom, 7 elements in 7 groups
specs.对焦: 5 point Multi-Beam Active AF, 650 focusing steps, 0.5 m - inf., Macro Mode focuses at fixed 0.25m.
specs.闪光灯: G.N. 24 m (ISO 100), Auto Fill-in, Soft Flash, Red-eye Reduction, Auto / On / Off
specs.英文简介: The Myport Zoom 90 is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1992 as the successor to their Myport Zoom RZ-800.
